items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Completes Record IPO and Closes First Trading Day Up 17%
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 完成史上最大 IPO，首日交易收盤上漲 17%
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, raising about $81.3 billion—the largest in history—and began trading on Nasdaq under ANT on November 19. Shares opened at $111.50 (up 34%) before closing at $97.17, a 17% gain from the IPO price, for a market value near $1.7–1.8 trillion. CEO Dario Amodei emphasized the company’s commitment to safety and public benefit.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 將 IPO 定價為每股 83 美元，籌集約 813 億美元（史上最大），並於 11 月 19 日以 ANT 代號在 Nasdaq 開始交易。股價開盤 111.50 美元（上漲 34%），收盤 97.17 美元，較發行價上漲 17%，市值約 1.7–1.8 兆美元。CEO Dario Amodei 強調公司對安全與公共利益的承諾。
items_flat.analysis_en: As the first pure-play frontier AI lab to go public, Anthropic’s debut provides a real-time public valuation benchmark for the sector. The initial pop followed by a partial fade, amid broader tech weakness, highlights both strong demand and lingering questions about AI profitability and capital intensity.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 作為首家上市的純前沿 AI 實驗室，Anthropic 的首秀為整個產業提供了即時公開估值基準。開盤大漲後部分回吐、同時科技股偏弱，顯示需求強勁但仍存在對 AI 獲利能力與資本密集度的疑問。
items_flat.quote: Today puts the company in a stronger financial position, and in doing so only strengthens our resolve to do the right thing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天讓公司財務地位更穩健，也因此只會強化我們做正確事情的決心。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind Rolls Out Gemini 4 Neon for Coding and Knowledge Work
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 4 Neon，專注編碼與知識工作
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen. It offers frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion, a 1M-token context, four thinking levels, and pricing of $3 / $15 per million input/output tokens. It scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh effort and ranks strongly on coding-agent benchmarks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Neon，定位於 Carbon 與 Hydrogen 之間。它提供前沿級智能與快速端到端任務完成、100 萬 token 上下文、四種思考層級，定價為每百萬輸入/輸出 token 3/15 美元。在 xhigh 努力下於 Artificial Analysis 智能指數得 61 分，並在編碼代理基準上表現強勁。
items_flat.analysis_en: Neon continues Google’s rapid cadence of Gemini 4 variants, aiming for better cost-per-task on agentic coding and science workflows. Independent confirmation of the claimed efficiency gains versus Carbon will be the key watchpoint.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Neon 延續 Google 快速推出 Gemini 4 變體的節奏，目標是在代理編碼與科學工作流程上降低每任務成本。獨立驗證其相對 Carbon 的效率優勢將是關鍵觀察點。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini 4 Neon——為複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學工作流程帶來前沿級智能與快速端到端任務完成。

items_flat.title_en: Google Launches Tool Retrieval in Gemini API for Large Agent Tool Libraries
items_flat.title_zh: Google 在 Gemini API 推出 Tool Retrieval，支援大規模代理工具庫
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced Tool Retrieval (preview) in the Gemini Interactions API. Agents can keep full tool libraries available while loading parameter schemas only on demand, reducing input tokens, latency, and selection errors when dealing with dozens or hundreds of tools. It works with Gemini 3.6+ including all Gemini 4 models and supports MCP servers.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 在 Gemini Interactions API 推出 Tool Retrieval（預覽版）。代理可保留完整工具庫，僅在需要時載入參數 schema，減少處理數十或上百個工具時的輸入 token、延遲與選擇錯誤。支援 Gemini 3.6 及所有 Gemini 4 模型，並相容 MCP 伺服器。
items_flat.analysis_en: This addresses a practical scaling bottleneck for production agents. By deferring schema loading while preserving prefix caching, Google is making high-tool-count workflows more economical and reliable, which matters more as agent platforms proliferate.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這解決了生產環境代理的實際擴展瓶頸。透過延遲載入 schema 同時保留前綴快取，Google 讓高工具數量的工作流程更經濟且可靠，在代理平台普及時尤其重要。
items_flat.quote: Tool Retrieval lets your agent keep its full tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when the current task needs them.
items_flat.quote_zh: Tool Retrieval 讓你的代理將完整工具庫待命，僅在當前任務需要時才載入參數 schema。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Details Performance Factory: Codex-Powered System Keeping ChatGPT Fast
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公開 Performance Factory：以 Codex 驅動的系統維持 ChatGPT 速度
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published an engineering post on its internal Performance Factory, an autonomous Codex-powered system that investigates and fixes performance regressions end-to-end. In over three months the Regression Workflow tracked more than 1,700 investigations and root-caused over 600 cases (about 17 per day). It includes adversarial review steps and human-in-the-loop deployment.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布工程文章，介紹內部 Performance Factory——以 Codex 驅動的自主系統，可端到端調查並修復效能回歸。超過三個月內，Regression Workflow 追蹤逾 1700 次調查並找出超過 600 個根本原因（平均每天約 17 次）。包含對抗性審查與人工審核部署環節。
items_flat.analysis_en: This shows how labs are applying agentic coding tools to their own infrastructure at scale. Success depends on the quality of adversarial checks and engineer review; early internal accuracy was reported around 70% before those safeguards.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這顯示實驗室正將代理式編碼工具大規模應用於自身基礎設施。成功取決於對抗性檢查與工程師審查的品質；加入防護前內部準確率約 70%。
items_flat.quote: The Performance Factory, which runs in the cloud and automates investigating and resolving performance problems, enables us to keep pace with the ambition of our roadmap.
items_flat.quote_zh: Performance Factory 在雲端運行並自動化調查與解決效能問題，讓我們能跟上路線圖的雄心。

items_flat.title_en: Meta’s Muse Wonder Tops Legora November BAR Legal Benchmark
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 的 Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月 BAR 法律基準中領先
items_flat.summary_en: AI at Meta highlighted that Muse Wonder earned the highest overall quality score in Legora’s November BAR benchmark for real-world legal tasks. It led in analysis and answering, extraction, drafting, and editing. GPT-6.2 Astra led on comparison/review while Sol offered strong quality at much lower cost.
items_flat.summary_zh: AI at Meta 指出，Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月 BAR 真實法律任務基準中獲得最高整體品質分數。它在分析與回答、抽取、起草與編輯類別領先。GPT-6.2 Astra 在比較/審查領先，Sol 則以遠低成本提供強勁品質。
items_flat.analysis_en: Legal work is a high-stakes, structured domain where small quality edges matter. Meta’s result is a useful external signal for Muse Wonder’s agentic strengths, though single-benchmark leadership does not equal broad superiority.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 法律工作是高風險且結構化的領域，小幅品質優勢很重要。Meta 的結果為 Muse Wonder 的代理能力提供有用外部訊號，但單一基準領先並不等於全面優勢。
items_flat.quote: Muse Wonder earned the highest overall quality score in Legora’s November BAR benchmark for legal work.
items_flat.quote_zh: Muse Wonder 在 Legora 11 月 BAR 法律工作基準中獲得最高整體品質分數。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Makes GPT-Live-1.1 Available in the Live API
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在 Live API 推出 GPT-Live-1.1
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1.1 in the Live API. The full-duplex voice model improves pronunciation, accent consistency, and transcription across languages, adds a cheaper standby/idle mode ($0.02/min), and strengthens instruction following. Developers can switch existing sessions to the new model ID.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 Live API 推出 GPT-Live-1.1。這款全雙工語音模型改善多語言發音、口音一致性與轉錄，新增較便宜的待命/閒置模式（每分鐘 0.02 美元），並強化指令遵循。開發者可將現有 session 切換至新模型 ID。
items_flat.analysis_en: Incremental but practical for production voice agents. The standby pricing lowers the cost of long-running or intermittent sessions, which is relevant as always-on agents become more common.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 對生產語音代理而言是漸進但實用的改進。待命定價降低長時間或間歇性 session 的成本，在常駐代理日益普遍時很有用。
items_flat.quote: GPT-Live-1.1 is now available in the API. It speaks with more natural and consistent accents across languages, supports lower idle costs with a new standby option, and completes tasks even more reliably.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-Live-1.1 現已在 API 推出。它以更自然且一致的多語言口音說話，支援新待命選項以降低閒置成本，並更可靠地完成任務。
